segments.label: Study Eric Mo: 10 months of no losing weeks, almost boring
segments.status: MINED 2026-11-22 (VTT 01:51:15.8 'And and so the 40% of the day trade money' to 01:53:40.1 'or exit at it close.'); cohort Zoom grid on screen: twin before public
segments.quote_anchor: Find the movers. Find the most volatile ones. Keep 70%. Lather, rinse, repeat. Preserve emotional resilience... What I really want you to do is study Eric Mo in cohort four. He's had 10 months in a row of no losing weeks. Trading exactly this way with about a dozen symbols... anywhere from 60 to 70% win rate in a given month and a payoff of 3 to one... it's almost boring for him, which is where I want you to be.
segments.why: the owner's pick: a student's record the coaching produced, and the line the preview is named for

text.title: **Griff Cooper**

segments.label: Griff: one symbol, three patterns, coached every night; no losing week in 2022
segments.status: MINED 2026-11-22 (VTT 00:58:02.2 'you talked to Griff Cooper' to 00:58:48.4 'hasn't had a losing week')
segments.quote_anchor: I told Griff stop what you're doing, pick either Brazil or DIA, trade one of these three patterns on a three-minute bar, nothing else... and I beat the living crap out of him in public on camera every night, and in the year 2022 he hasn't had a losing month, he hasn't had a losing week.
segments.why: what coaching is: narrow the task, repeat it, get feedback every night

segments.label: Griff: follow these rules exactly until I tell you to stop; 20 hours, 10 minutes a night
